text: An observed call counts toward a proof only when the application's own code made it (#807's review, P-0793). Each recorded call names the staged file whose code called the function, and a call qualifies an in-place proof only from a file among the manifest's existing sources, never from the driver, a test helper or a callback the driver hands the application. Without this a driver could make the calls itself and have the gate report a function proved in an application that never calls it. A replay is compared with its attempt by the set of calls made, since worker threads finish in an order that varies.
